tagline: Provider of communications systems-on-chip for broadband, mobile and wireline infrastructure
hero_kpi_rationale: Broadband segment revenue represents 44% of total revenue and increased by 75% in 2025 compared to 2024, demonstrating strong demand for high-speed connectivity solutions.

kpis.name: Broadband segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from broadband connectivity products (DOCSIS modems, PON, DSL, and SoCs)
kpis.description: Broadband segment revenue is a key driver of company growth, representing 44% of total revenue in 2025.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in broadband segment revenue

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin, calculated as gross profit divided by net sales
kpis.description: Gross margin improved to 57% in 2025 versus 54% in 2024, driven by favorable product mix and lower amortization of acquired intangible assets.
kpis.signal: Gross margin improvement due to favorable product mix and reduced amortization of intangible assets

kpis.name: Research and development expenses

kpis.description: R&D expenses decreased from $16.6M in 2025 to $208.6M, primarily due to payroll reductions and cost-reduction measures, partially offset by higher bonuses and stock-based compensation.
